text_block_list.name: Racer A
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Phew! Well done everyone! That was some race!

text_block_list.name: Racer A
text_block_list.text:
Wait... isn't that Manhattan Cafe over
there?
Hey, good job today...

text_block_list.name: Racer A
text_block_list.text: Huh, didn't she hear me? Um...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe turns away from the
other runner
and gazes into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...My friend won. She took off by herself,
shot
past the finish line... and kept
going... into the
distance...
choice_data_list: レースはどうなったの？

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
She seemed so happy, getting to run in a
vast
space like this. But at the same
time...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
She ran so, so fast... it was like she was
set free
from something. The distance
between us was
greater than I'd ever
seen...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I want to catch up to her, but... how can
I do
that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Judging from what Manhattan Cafe's
told me, her
Friend is significantly faster
than her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So a quick-fix plan won't get us
anywhere.
Meaning...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Little by little... That's going to take a
while...
choice_data_list: 目標レースは定めず、地道に強化しよう

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I am. If you say rushing is out of the
question,
then that's that...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Besides, this might be just what I need...
Since my
body isn't very strong...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She nods, moves to my side, then vows
to chase
after our goal together.

text_block_list.name: Racer A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't you think those two are kinda
weird?
Staring off into the distance like
that.

text_block_list.name: Racer B
text_block_list.text:
I guess they're both weirdos... Let's keep
our
distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll try to make sense of the things that
only
Manhattan Cafe can understand as
we continue
racking up achievements
together.
